scope: Issue 74 conditional continuity-axis recommendation only; no issue 75 implementation or test-identity claim
ownership: Independent data specification. Main implements generator/validator. Do not alter these expectations to fit detector outputs.

provenance.dynamics: Prescribed kinematics, with no force/contact/inertia model. Rapid intersample turn is a mathematical observation-equivalence control, not a validated human/robot maneuver.
provenance.already_seen_inputs: Existing public18/public32 and their known trajectories remain regression/calibration inputs, not this new held-out set.

profile.source: New independently declared literal geometry for continuity recommendation evaluation; no capture-derived coordinates

coordinate_contract.local: fixed box axes X/Y/Z; origin is geometric center
coordinate_contract.floor_note: Declared virtual reference only; no contact/support test interpretation.

sampling.time_s: i/125, derived from integer i; inclusive final sample 1.920 s

interpolation.s: S(u)=10*u^3-15*u^4+6*u^5, u=(i-k0)/(k1-k0), 0<=u<=1; valid for real i=t/dt too
interpolation.orientation: componentwise interpolate listed degree angles using S, convert to radians, then R=Rx(ax)@Ry(ay)@Rz(az). This matrix product is authoritative; do not infer a SciPy Euler case convention.
interpolation.endpoints: No extrapolation; exact knot values; repeated knots values create a true rest.

corruption_algebra.persistent_event: At inclusive frame k, F becomes F@H_axis for all following solved samples; F initially I. R_observed=R_truth@F. Expected recommendation is this event incremental local axis, not the absolute accumulated F.
corruption_algebra.order: truth pose -> cumulative solved transform -> additive solved XYZ Gaussian noise -> explicit missing/freeze masks. Freeze copies already noised observed values from stated source frame.
corruption_algebra.noise: NumPy Generator(PCG64(seed)).normal(0,sigma_mm,size=(241,24,3)), ordered frame then profile marker order then XYZ. Never perturb truth.
corruption_algebra.channel: Rigid Body Marker positions only; omit physical Marker channels for every recording. Do not export true physical coordinates as extra evidence.
corruption_algebra.coverage: A missing marker has all XYZ NaN; timestamps and frame IDs remain present.

expected.pairs: 40/80 is XX returning to I; 144/184 is XY from I ending at Z.
expected.missing: No recommendation based on missing samples alone; preserve invalid coverage and interval uncertainty.
expected.freeze_reconnect: No half-turn recommendation for freeze or reconnect with unchanged solved F.

recordings.observed_definition: Use family A origin and R_A@H_X at every sample i>=112; otherwise R_A. Write exactly one solved-only observed CSV and static profile shared by both oracle interpretations.

oracle_interpretations.fault: persistent local X solved half-turn at frame112, time0.896

oracle_interpretations.true_rotation: R_A(t)@Rx(pi*S((t-0.888)/0.008)) for 0.888<=t<=0.896; R_A before; R_A@H_X afterwards. At sampled endpoints this produces exactly the same solved observations.
oracle_interpretations.warning: No intersample observations exist; prescribed rapid turn is not a claim about physically feasible handling.

expected.compute_once: Evaluate shared observed input once; compare the same output against both distinct oracle narratives. Require a single observed SHA; no second processing run.

true_motion_extra.rotation: R_true=R_B@Ry(pi*S((i-32)/32)) during [32,64], R_B before, R_B@H_Y after. Continuous sampled motion, not a solved half-turn.

expected.resolved_true_turn: No half-turn recommendation on the sampled smooth 180-degree motion. Never classify it as tracking error or approve correction.
expected.unsupported_90: At frames112 and144 the 90-degree change has no uniquely supported X/Y/Z half-turn correction; retain no recommendation/ambiguity.
expected.unsupported_arbitrary: At frame176 the 60-degree arbitrary-axis change is closer to the unchanged state than to an X/Y/Z half-turn; no recommendation.
expected.low_coverage: Frames208..215 have only 2 markers; do not certify an axis across missing geometry.
expected.translation_offset: At frame224 the position jump alone is not evidence for a local X/Y/Z half-turn; no recommendation.

evaluation_contract.conditional_recommendation: If this selected event were corrected, the proposed local half-turn reduces the observed discontinuity. This is not evidence that a tracking error occurred.
label_leakage_prohibited: Do not pass this JSON, truth, error events, expected axes, generator case IDs, or scenario trial labels to detector/analysis.
Production receives only neutral-name observed CSV, static geometry, and normal user approval metadata if explicitly applied.
Use SourceKind handcrafted_dummy; no synthetic error or motion-family answer in source metadata.
evaluation_contract.evaluation_order: Freeze this file and SHA before implementation output inspection. Generate observations/independent truth separately, run production on observed, then compare outcomes. Preserve failures; do not tune these held-out expectations.
evaluation_contract.boundaries: Exact event frame is ground truth for isolated sampled jumps; a detector candidate may cover neighboring frames. Its review range must contain the transition between frames k-1 and k. Do not pretend a missing interval gives an exact error onset.
evaluation_contract.score_tolerances: Use pre-existing product acceptance thresholds. Do not invent or widen thresholds here to obtain a pass. Report candidate coverage and score/margin separately from axis/cause/approval state.
evaluation_contract.posthoc_changes: If this set drives a fix or tuning, disclose it as an independently specified challenge set and rerun only affected checks; do not report it as untouched final statistical validation.
evaluation_contract.minimum_runs: Four observed captures total, two base trajectory families, one analysis per capture. The equal-observation pair is one input with two oracle interpretations; no full case Cartesian product.

gui_candidate: recording_01 for event recommendation -> explicit user approval -> corrected save/reopen; recording_03 ambiguity text can reuse its single observed analysis. No new full GUI processing matrix required.
